findings.problem: The Wikipedia link sits directly after "Sarah Cushing", but the linked page (re-fetched 2026-09-11) says she was cast "as Sarah Cortez in Superman & Lois (2021)". A reader who clicks to check the name finds the other name. Cushing is supported by CBR (2021-03-15) and Just Jared Jr. (2023-04-07), neither linked at this point.
findings.acceptance_test: The source linked beside "Sarah Cushing" uses that name (for example the CBR 2021 interview), or the Wikipedia link moves to the facts it supports (2021 casting, 13 Reasons Why), so no link contradicts the adjacent wording.

findings.passage: wanting to be "very discerning" with new projects because "I don't want to lose the audience's trust in me."
findings.problem: In S10 14:30-14:46 the trust reason is attached to a different clause: "I'm really trying to be specific with it cuz I don't want to lose the audience's trust in me... The sense (choosy about projects to keep audience trust) survives, so this is minor.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence attaches the trust quote to her being "specific" about projects, or paraphrases both reasons without a connective she did not use. Quoted words remain verbatim.

findings.acceptance_test: The transition reads "in the same answer" or "moments later" (or quotes the intervening lines), so the order claimed matches Nylon.
